editorial.blurb: This beloved neighborhood Vietnamese spot tucked beside an Asian supermarket delivers authentic, heartfelt cooking at prices that feel like a gift.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Bun Bo Hue for its tender beef and spicy-sour broth, or ask about their lemongrass porkchop—reviewers call it the best they've ever had. Come before or after hitting the Park to Shop next door.
